links.comparator_used: Same LLMs without retrieval augmentation (no RAG)
links.outcome: Faithfulness (answer supported by source text) on 70 curated question-answer pairs
links.effect: Faithfulness increased by 64.7 percentage points to 99.5% for RAG-enhanced O4-Mini
links.quote: Faithfulness, the measure of whether an answer is supported by the source text, was increased by 64.7 percentage points to 99.5% for the RAG-enhanced O4-Mini model and significantly outperformed the medical-focused Meditron3-8B LLM, which scored 43%.

links.effect: Meditron3-8B scored 43% versus 99.5% for RAG-enhanced O4-Mini
